Select IC50 activity rows for human TGF-beta receptor type I (CHEMBL4439). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Join compound_records and docs to retrieve compound_key and pubmed_id_or_doi. Filter for standard_type = 'IC50' and require both canonical_smiles and pubmed_id_or_doi to be present. Return all requested columns including compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
